ApplyOfficial application page ↗

Tuition coverage to check

The advertised package covers Home-rate tuition. It should not be treated as full international-fee funding: confirm your fee status and any overseas-fee difference with the university before accepting.

About the Studentship

The Magdalen Vernon PhD Studentship is named in honour of Professor Magdalen Vernon, who was the first woman to serve as Head of the former Department of Psychology at Reading. The School of Psychology and Clinical Language Sciences is seeking a doctoral researcher whose proposed project fits its research strengths.

Research Areas

Suitable research areas include: psychology; psychopathology; emotional disorders; affective neuroscience; cognitive neuroscience; psycholinguistics; neurolinguistics; bilingualism; clinical language science; perception and action; cognitive control; motivation; behaviour change; and related fields.

Funding

The current 2027 advertisement lists: £22,437 maintenance allowance; £1,000 Research Training Support Grant per year; tuition-fee support; and a three-year studentship.

Fee-status note

There is currently a wording difference between sources. The current Jobs.ac.uk advertisement specifies that the 2027 competition is restricted to applicants qualifying for Home fee status. The University of Reading's broader Magdalen Vernon information page states that the studentship covers fees at the Home or International rate. Because the current vacancy advert is more specific to this recruitment round, applicants should confirm fee eligibility directly with the School before relying on international-fee coverage.

Academic Eligibility

Applicants should normally have a good undergraduate degree, typically a First or 2:1, in an area such as: psychology; neuroscience; linguistics; speech and language therapy; or another closely related subject. A relevant master's qualification can strengthen an application but is not described as universally mandatory.

Required Application Documents

The current advertisement asks applicants to submit: online PhD application; CV; academic transcripts; degree certificates; research proposal of approximately 500–700 words, excluding references; and the separate Magdalen Vernon Studentship application form. Applicants should enter DRC27-001 in the scholarship/funding section. Applicants are also strongly encouraged to discuss their research idea with an appropriate academic member of staff before applying.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 4 December 2026. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
